description: A reactive object living outside the component tree, shared by every component that calls its `useXxxStore()` function.
Declares a store. The `id` is unique and must be the first argument.
A store described with `state`, `getters` and `actions`, mirroring the Options API.
A cached computed value derived from state. Receives `state`; can use `this` to reach other getters.
A method (sync or async) that changes state through `this`. Replaces Vuex mutations and actions.
Restores the initial state by calling `state()` again. Only available on option stores.
Applies a partial object or a mutator function to the state as a single change.
